task.launch.label: Launch game
task.launch.description: Start the game, handle Google sign-in, notices and loading, land on home
task.gift.label: Claim gifts
task.gift.description: Home -> present box -> claim all -> confirm pages -> back to home; returns directly when empty
task.home.label: Back to home
task.home.description: Tap back repeatedly from any screen until the home bottom navigation shows up
task.live.label: Play one live
task.live.description: Home -> LIVE -> solo live -> enable AUTO -> start -> wait for the end -> clear result pages -> back home
task.settle.label: Finish live result
task.settle.description: Clear the result screens of a live that already ended: tap LIVE CLEAR, confirm each page, back home
task.enterlive.label: Open live deck
task.enterlive.description: Home -> LIVE -> solo -> decide, stop at the deck screen (no play, no live bonus spent)
task.story.label: Read stories
task.story.description: Auto-read main/event stories: no skip, no fast-forward, plain tap-through until no unread chapters remain
task.challenge.label: Daily challenge
task.challenge.description: Daily challenge live: consumes no live bonus, once per day; picks the available character, plays with AUTO and settles
task.farm.label: Spend live bonus
task.farm.description: Auto-live until no live bonus remains, settling every result and returning home
task.sidestory.label: Read side stories (WIP)
task.sidestory.description: Side stories: reaches the character select, but the list is a 前編/後編 card grid with level locks — picking an unlocked card is not implemented
task.mission.label: Claim missions
task.mission.description: Home -> mission icon -> claim all -> confirm -> home
